note: High Floor forward test. Started November 17, 2026 at 0-0. Singles only, locked at publish, graded daily.
rule: A test, not picks. Singles only: Over legs where the player cleared the line in at least 8 of the last 10 games and in at least 75% of this season's games, with a consensus line posted.
One leg per game and at most 5 a day. If more qualify, we keep the highest last 10 count, then the season hit rate. NBA threes are left out.
Legs lock at the 7 AM Arizona publish with the consensus line, odds and implied chance. No swaps and no backfill. The record starts at 0-0 on November 17, 2026.
Graded from the final box score. Losses are listed with their dates.
It needs about 300 graded legs, roughly 8 to 9 weeks. It passes only if the hit rate beats the market chance by about 4 to 5 points. If it does not, we retire it.
Floor scores, market chances and defense ranks are estimates. No stakes or profit are tracked. Not betting advice.
